note: Week one rebuilt 2026-10-06 from docs/learning/AUDIENCE_RESEARCH_ISLAM.md: 1 bismillah, 2 al-Fatiha (what your prayer says, whole), 3 wudu, 4 inshallah (+ mashallah), 5 iman (is doubt okay?), 6 Ramadan (suhoor to iftar), 7 Eid (the two Eids); salaam moved to 8, the five pillars to 9, salat to 10, alhamdulillah to 11, al-Fatiha's verses to 12–16 (verse seven folded into 16; amin dropped), the adhan to 17, Jumu'ah to 18; dhikr left camp one (its own week is days 113–119).

checkin.q: the one thing al-Fatiha asks for is…
once you've made wudu, it lasts…
options: until something breaks it, like sleep.

checkin.q: inshallah looks ahead. mashallah looks at…
options: a plan that probably won't happen.
a meal you're about to eat.

checkin.q: when companions confessed thoughts they could hardly say, the Prophet ﷺ called their worry…
the Qur'an says the fast is for…
Eid al-Adha, the second Eid, remembers…
options: Ibrahim, and the ram given in place of his son.

2: the opening: seven verses said in every prayer
the last surah of the Qur'an
3: the washing before prayer: a reset with water
a full bath once a week
4: if God wills: a plan held with an open hand
5: faith: from a root of safety and trust
6: the month of fasting, dawn to sunset
a feast at the end of the year
7: a feast that returns: one after the fast, one at the pilgrimage
8: peace: a greeting that's a wish
9: witness, prayer, giving, fasting, pilgrimage: a house built on five
10: the set prayer: standing, bowing, forehead to the ground
any prayer in your own words
a song sung at the mosque
12: the Lord who raises and looks after
a king who rules from far away
13: mercy, from the root of womb
14: the Day when every account is settled
16: the straight path, asked for in every prayer
17: the call to prayer, from the root for ear
18: a full day of rest from work
19: the yearly giving: a share of savings, for people in need
a tax paid to the state
20: Muhammad, the messenger, called al-Amin before his prophethood
21: the last of the Qur'an's thirty parts: the short surahs

bet.reveal: in the name of God. bi, in; ism, name; Allah, God. it goes before almost anything that begins, so nothing starts alone.
